    oe.fillsum as position_notional_value,

    SELECT MAX(md2.marketdatanode) FROM marketdata md2 GROUP BY md2.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo'
)
ORDER BY oe.fillsum DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.riskandmarginpivot,
        (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum')::numeric as position_notional_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum')::numeric DESC) as rn
    FROM riskandmargin rm
),
volatility AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (md.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo') 
           md.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo' as mktcombo,
           ms.volmeter
    FROM marketdata md
    JOIN marketstats ms ON md.marketdatanode = ms.mdlink
    ORDER BY md.quote_depth_snapshot->'metadata'->>'mktcombo', md.marketdatanode DESC
)
SELECT 
    r.riskandmarginpivot,
    r.position_notional_value,
    v.volmeter as volatility_measure,
    r.position_notional_value * v.volmeter / 100.0 as pvar_calculated
FROM ranked r
JOIN orders o ON r.riskandmarginpivot = (SELECT riskandmarginpivot FROM riskandmargin WHERE ordervault = o.recordvault LIMIT 1)
JOIN volatility v ON o.mktnote = v.mktcombo
WHERE r.rn <= 5;
